content.text: {"concept_key":"c7-science-photosynthesis","title":"Photosynthesis","quick":"Green plants make their own food (glucose) in leaves using sunlight, water and carbon dioxide. Oxygen is released as a by-product. Chlorophyll (green pigment) traps sunlight for this process.","full":"Think of a leaf like a tiny kirana shop kitchen: it takes raw materials - water (from roots) and carbon dioxide (from air) - and with sunlight as energy, cooks them into glucose (food) inside chlorophyll-containing cells. What's needed: sunlight, water, CO2, chlorophyll. What's produced: glucose (food/energy for the plant) and oxygen (released into air, which we breathe). The same way a cook needs ingredients plus fire (energy) to make roti, the leaf needs raw materials plus sunlight (energy) to make glucose.","traps":["Writing that plants 'eat' food from soil instead of making it themselves","Forgetting that oxygen is released, not taken in, during photosynthesis","Mixing up photosynthesis with respiration (which uses oxygen, releases CO2)"],"misconception":"Children often think plants get their food directly from soil, like absorbing 'food' through roots, rather than making glucose themselves using sunlight.","parent_questions":[{"q":"What three things does a leaf need to make its own food?","expected_answer_hint":"Sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide (with chlorophyll to trap sunlight)."},{"q":"What two things come out of the leaf after photosynthesis?","expected_answer_hint":"Glucose (food for the plant) and oxygen (released into the air)."}],"check_question":{"q":"Ravi keeps a plant in a dark cupboard for a week. What will most likely happen?","options":["The plant will stop making food and weaken","The plant will make more food than usual","The plant will make food using only water"],"correct_index":0,"right_feedback":"Correct! Without sunlight, the plant cannot carry out photosynthesis to make food.","wrong_feedback":"Not quite. Without sunlight, there's no energy for photosynthesis, so the plant can't make food and will weaken."},"illustration":{"scene_prompt":"A sunny garden with a green leafy plant, sunlight rays falling on its leaves, with a watering can nearby.","labels":[{"text":"sunlight","position":"top"},{"text":"water","position":"bottom-left"},{"text":"carbon dioxide","position":"left"},{"text":"oxygen","position":"right"}]}}
